newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Highlights of Wednesday's Commission briefing.
newsitem.headline: Highlights of Wednesday's Commission briefing.

text.p: Following are highlights of the midday briefing by the European Commission on Wednesday:

Spokesman Peter Guilford said Commissioner Sir Leon Brittan had made a statement on the Commission's views of national security questions and on the procedures to be followed for the next couple of weeks. Guilford said the Commission had asked World Trade Organisation Director General Renato Ruggiero to postpone the nomination of the WTO dispute panel over the Helms-Burton law for one week (see separate story:

Guilford said U.S. Secretary of State Madeleine Albright would meet Commission President Jacques Santer and other Commissioners next week. He said discussions would notably cover the Helms-Burton dispute.

Spokesman Nikolaus van der Pas said the Commission had decided to fund industrial restructuring in German and French regions under the Objective 2 Programme. He said it had also decided on the calendar for the Portuguese telecoms liberalisation.
Van der Pas briefed on the Commission's decision to restructure its services in the framework of the BSE crisis (see separate story: MADCOW-MEASURES).
Van der Pas said the Commission had named Horst Reichenbach, Commissioner Monika Wulf-Mathies' former Chief Aide, as the new DGXXIV Director General.
The Commission released the following documents:
- IP/97/107: Commission funds Spanish farm-produce industry (La Rioja).
- IP/97/110: 68 Mecus for industrial regions in Lower Saxony and Schleswig Holstein.
- IP/97/112: The Commission restructures its services in the framework of human food health.
- IP/97/114: The Commission investigates restructuring aid to Keller SpA and Keller Meccanica SpA in Italy.
- IP/97/115: The Commission takes two positive decisions concerning Dutch research and development projects related to the environment.
- IP/97/116: Commission opens procedure concerning a FF 2.5 billion state aid scheme for Societe Francaise de Production.
- IP/97/117: Commission gives conditional go ahead for the extension of special depreciation arrangements and the taxation investment bonus for West-Berlin.
- IP/97/118: The Commission approves timetable for full telecommunications liberalisation in Portugal.
- IP/97/119: The Commission presents its fifth research framework programme.
